title: Home practical guide and safety card: pinhole viewer
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y6 lesson 19 (Home practical guide and safety card: pinhole viewer (portal worksheet; adult makes the pinhole, never point at the Sun))
intro: Lesson 19: Making a pinhole viewer. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To make a pinhole viewer and see an image
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Tape foil over one end of the tube
An adult makes a tiny pinhole in the foil
Tape tracing paper over the other end as a screen
Point the pinhole at a bright window or lamp; never at the Sun
Look at the screen with a cloth over your head
Draw the image and say what is odd about it

questions.q: Big question: how can straight rays make the image upside down?
questions.a: Rays from the top go straight through the hole to the bottom of the screen, so they cross.
